source_pr_title: fix(openshift-compat): host keys 0600 — OpenSSH rejects group bits
author: cubic-dev-ai
body:

P2: When a peer creates a directory at the key path, this cleanup recursively deletes everything inside it, not just the invalid key object. Remove only a symlink/non-directory with `rm -f` and use `rmdir` for an empty directory, or fail safely when the directory is non-empty.

<details>
<summary>Prompt for AI agents</summary>

```text
Check if this issue is valid — if so, understand the root cause and fix it. At modules/infra/openshift-compat.nix, line 77:

<comment>When a peer creates a directory at the key path, this cleanup recursively deletes everything inside it, not just the invalid key object. Remove only a symlink/non-directory with `rm -f` and use `rmdir` for an empty directory, or fail safely when the directory is non-empty.</comment>

<file context>
@@ -58,16 +58,23 @@ in
+      # A readable non-regular object (dir, fifo, dangling symlink) at the
+      # key path must not bypass regeneration — sshd would fail to load it.
+      if [[ ! -f "$SSH_KEY" || ! -r "$SSH_KEY" ]]; then
+        rm -rf "$SSH_KEY"; rm -f "$SSH_KEY.pub"
         if ! ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f "$SSH_KEY" -N ""; then
           echo "sshd: failed to generate host key in $SSH_KEY_DIR" >&2
</file context>
```

</details>

```suggestion
        if [[ -d "$SSH_KEY" && ! -L "$SSH_KEY" ]]; then
          rmdir "$SSH_KEY" 2>/dev/null || {
            echo "sshd: cannot remove non-empty key path $SSH_KEY" >&2
            exit 1
          }
        else
          rm -f "$SSH_KEY"
        fi
        rm -f "$SSH_KEY.pub"
```
